_readme.note: Hand-set geography for meetups the geocoder cannot place on its own. Keys are "<Date>|<Venue>", copied from data/meetups-geo.csv (whitespace is normalised on both sides, so spacing does not have to match). An entry may carry: query (a better search string, or a list tried in order), lat + lon (set outright, skipping the geocoder), and city/district/state (labels laid over whatever came back). An entry also means a human has checked the row, so it stops being flagged. This file is committed, so npm run geocode:meetups keeps every fix. Keys without a | are never looked up, which is why this note is safe here.
